request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:1

layers.text: Recolour the dark brown timber walls of the hut and the dark brown lookout pole to light grey riveted scrap iron with blue-grey shading, with no brown anywhere, and make the three tents and the flag a brighter solid red. Change nothing else: keep the shapes, the patches, the chimney, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
